name: Vizly
long_description:
Vizly helps you get the most out of your data by turning it into actionable insights in seconds. Whether you're a researcher, professor, data analyst, or business leader, Vizly's AI capabilities enable you to visualize, analyze, and interpret your data effortlessly.

For example, Vizly can automatically generate interactive visualizations, perform detailed statistical analyses, and offer predictive insights, making your data analysis workflow seamless.

Before Vizly, Ali built out people-based AI recommendations at Apple and Sami built mission-critical data visualization systems at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.

launches.title: Vizly – Chat with your data
launches.tagline: Query your data using natural language
launches.body:
### TL;DR - Explore your Data by Asking Questions, No External APIs Required

Built by Apple and NASA engineers, [Vizly](https://www.vizly.fyi/) is an on-premises, AI-powered data analysis tool that allows users to perform data tasks using plain English. Instead of learning complicated BI tools, customers and enterprises can use Vizly to get AI-powered data analysis, without exposing any of their sensitive data to unsecure external APIs.

### **The Problem**

BI tools are complicated and have a steep learning curve to use. Despite enterprises shifting to data-centric cultures, the adoption rate of BI tools in enterprise has remained at **only 15%** \[1\]. With more people wanting to access data, existing BI tools have not kept up. This has left data teams to pick up the slack with analysts often spending large portions of their day fighting a barrage of data questions.

### **Our Solution**

With [Vizly](https://www.vizly.fyi/), we are building a dead simple BI tool that runs fully on-premises and allows anyone to perform their data tasks using plain English. Instead of needing expensive hardware to run, a Vizly instance is both powerful enough and small enough to run even on a single MacBook.

A single employee can set up Vizly on their machine by simply selecting the data sources and sharing a link with their non-technical colleagues. With just a link, anyone in the enterprise can explore the shared data sources using plain English. It operates securely behind the firewall, ensuring no data ever leaves the enterprise network.

# Vizly

Try it out [here](https://www.vizly.fyi/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74490&key=user_uploads/634427/7bafc4a8-fe78-4f8d-9449-78279f199001)

Vizly makes data analysis as easy as asking a question.

# **The Team**

Sami and I met at McGill University and have been friends for almost a decade. We previously built and sold [YouTube Party](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/youtube-party/ngmncgebkdchkdokiecifpmodajbaopj) together, a project that gained over 300K weekly active users.

Now we are using our expertise from NASA and Apple to build the next generation of enterprise BI tools.

Previous experience at Plotly, building one of the most widely downloaded low-code data tools.

[Ali](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ali-shobeiri/): Machine learning engineer at Apple, building out people-based recommendations. If you’ve ever shared a photo on your iPhone, or done autocomplete searches, you used a model Ali deployed. Previous experience at Plotly, Microsoft, and Unity Research.
